title: Vignette 2026-10-30: SRS needs a graph element

sections.name: narrative

sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "Let's build a research section in srs-programme. We already have some ongoing explorations into flow and decisions. Now I want to do the same for the graph.
SRS needs to have a graph element, I just need to gather the evidence and tell the right story."
